method.read_access: NCBI Run Browser deterministic dispersed spot-ID queries
method.phase_a: Exact target-kmer overlap; target k-mer or reverse-complement accepted.
method.phase_b: Only 15-mers uniquely attributable to one target locus were counted; best locus required >=5 unique-locus k-mer hits for the strong-read summary.

phase_a.interpretation: Mixed target-rich and target-poor reads are expected because the experiment design mixed unenriched and target-enriched libraries 3:2.

claim_boundary: This deterministic spot sample is not a random-sampling estimate of capture efficiency.
Run Browser retrieval was incomplete for some requested spot IDs and is used only as an independent technical check.
No reference-transferability, locus-recovery fraction, orthology, local ancestry, genomic modularity, or genotype-phenotype inference is authorized.
Primary R1B-0 evidence remains full-run HybPiper locus recovery followed by frozen orthology and cross-reference localization.
